Country/Region of Origin: South America (Venezuela, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, and to some extent Colombia).
Time Period: Brought to South America around World War II (German Jews and others fled to South America; game name from German firm Telefunken).
Historical Development: Contract rummy variant played especially in Venezuela, Ecuador, Peru and Bolivia; not played in Germany nowadays.
Cultural Significance: Popular in several South American countries; regional variants in Ecuador, Peru (two versions), Bolivia, and a North American variation (Farmers' Rummy).

Minimum Players: 2
